verdict.rationale: Granola's site says it works with Zoom, Google Meet, Teams and other meeting apps. It captures computer audio rather than sending a bot, and a calendar notification opens the call and starts transcribing. It detects when a call ends or lets you stop manually, and also covers in-person meetings, any computer audio, and phone calls on mobile, so capture can happen wherever the user chooses. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on evidence that capture is reliable on each named platform, and any documentation of saved audio recordings or control over where recordings are stored (only transcripts are evidenced).
